alerts.headline: Reliance shares may climb to Rs 1,575 in 3-4 months, says Manas Jaiswal
alerts.summary: Jaiswal said that Rs 1,100-1,150 levels have emerged as a crucial support for Reliance Industries. He noted that the stock had rallied towards the Rs 1,600 level three times over the past three years after finding support in this range.

alerts.headline: Latest earnings season is raising the bar on the AI theme; tactically neutral on India, says BlackRock's Ben Powell
alerts.summary: The October 30 US equities sell-off wiped billions off US technology stocks as investors questioned whether record AI spending can translate into earnings and cash flows.

alerts.headline: Deven Choksey sets Rs 1,800 target on Reliance, sees scope for an upgrade
alerts.summary: Deven Choksey retains a Rs 1,800 target for Reliance Industries, citing strong O2C margins and undervaluation of its Jio Platforms stake. He sees further upside potential.
